relationships.evidence_quote: reductions in the serum levels of TNF-α, IL-1β, IL-6, MOD, and prostaglandin E2 (PGE2)

relationships.subject: PRE-084
relationships.evidence_quote: PRE-084 increased phosphorylation of serine/threonine protein kinase B (AKT) and glycogen synthase kinase 3β (GSK-3β) at Ser9, inhibiting nuclear factor kappa B (NF-κB)-mediated neuroinflammation in the dorsal root ganglion

key_findings: Sig-1R agonist PRE-084 improved pain thresholds and reduced TNF-α, IL-1β, IL-6, PGE2 and COX-2 in diabetic neuropathic pain rats
Effect proceeds via AKT/GSK-3β phosphorylation and suppression of NF-κB signaling in the DRG
